title: Erdos Problem 848: Kernel-Checked Lean Proof Source Archive
description: Source archive for the unconditional Lean kernel proof of Erdos Problem 848. The archived proof endpoint is Erdos848.PaperGeneratedCertificateProvider.all_N. The proof-source checkpoint is commit 455d082973ba36f8174d3a98b62c97793d22c1a5; this release adds archive metadata only and does not change the proof sources. Manuscript prose and rendered PDFs are intentionally excluded from this software archive.
